A seamless loop has no extra endpoint frame: For N frames in one cycle, phases i/N keep the wrap step equal to every other step.
Wraparound indexing: % is remainder, not modulo, in JS/C/Java: (i - 1) % n goes negative for i = 0. Use ((i % n) + n) % n when stepping backward through a loop or ring buffer.
